title: The Moon
source_film: A Trip to the Moon / Le Voyage dans la Lune (Georges Méliès, 1902)
audience: New player learning the confirmed gestures and baseline close-range combat

campaign_constraints.voluntary_movement: directional swipes cause ground-plane X/Z dashes only
campaign_constraints.attack: immediate tap slash; nearby second quick tap chains one blast; aim from final swipe release
campaign_constraints.weapon: one carried weapon; pickup replaces current weapon; no hotbar
campaign_constraints.damage: fixed baseline damage; no persistent damage growth
campaign_constraints.broader_environment_interactables: future topic after enemy behaviour; do not expand roster here

gesture_coordinate_rule.player_aim_anchor: screen-space final finger-release endpoint of the latest swipe
gesture_coordinate_rule.attack_vector: from that stored endpoint to tap position; no target redirection
gesture_coordinate_rule.confirmed_example: final release upper-left then centre tap strikes down-right regardless of player world position
gesture_coordinate_rule.anchor_updates: final finger release, not swipe threshold crossing
gesture_coordinate_rule.camera_movement: does not move or reinterpret screen-space anchor
gesture_coordinate_rule.second_tap: one blast after first slash; nearby tap within current prototype 280 ms
gesture_coordinate_rule.screen_edge_remedy: ordinary positioning swipe ending at a useful screen point; no separate aim-only gesture
gesture_coordinate_rule.enemy_targeting: actual world-space position/lane; distinct from finger-release endpoint
gesture_coordinate_rule.teaching_cue: optional short-lived anchor/direction demonstration; must not alter confirmed mapping

checkpoints.saved_markers: save on completed exercise/encounter/phase, not a timed autosave
checkpoints.retry: restore coherent section start, intended supplies and enemy positions; no active warning at load
checkpoints.backgrounding: freeze all simulation including cooldowns, warnings, spores, temporary effects and boss logic
checkpoints.resume: consume overlay tap; continue frozen state without accidental slash or blast
checkpoints.cleared_rooms: stay safe; no unannounced respawn behind player

regular_enemies.name: Rush Selenite
regular_enemies.canonical_status: invented game variant of film Selenite family
regular_enemies.role: short committed rush lane; stopped body slashable in recovery

regular_enemies.name: Swarm Selenite
regular_enemies.canonical_status: invented game variant of film Selenite family
regular_enemies.role: crowd approach with individually telegraphed short hopping strikes; repelled by spores

regular_enemies.name: Spear Guard
regular_enemies.canonical_status: invented game variant of film Selenite family
regular_enemies.role: braced short thrust lane; lowered-spear recovery; formation reuse in court

enemy_tuning_proposals.swarm_health_hypothesis: one ordinary slash; verify with fixed baseline damage

spore_interaction.confirmed_direction: hittable spores on mushrooms fall around mushroom and temporarily repel enemies
spore_interaction.affected_enemies: regular Selenites, including rushers and spear guards
spore_interaction.activation: ordinary hit on low reachable cluster; normal slash viable
spore_interaction.enemy_response: cancel current attack, recoil, turn and retreat beyond field; avoid it until thinning ends
spore_interaction.tradeoff: spend finite supply now to create space or save an escape opening for later
spore_interaction.extra_hit_during_release_or_field: consume no second cluster and do not refresh; slash-then-blast does not spend two
spore_interaction.field_collision: predictable floor boundary; decorative falling particles do not determine affected enemies

levels.name: Observatory and Launch
levels.subtitle: The Launch Rehearsal
levels.objective: Complete the launch rehearsal and reach the capsule hatch
levels.skill: Choose a useful dash landing and deliberately aim from the final swipe release
levels.mood: friendly ceremony; comic scientific ambition; lively preparation

levels.skill: Choose a formation gap and prioritise a reachable recovery target
levels.mood: ceremonial opposition; comic authority; first boss confidence

beats.name: Curtain entrance
beats.purpose: One familiar guard in open floor without a mushroom

beats.name: Formation court
beats.purpose: Parallel pair then inward pair; wide gaps and staggered commitments

beats.name: Royal approach
beats.purpose: Quiet roundel-impact demonstration then familiar guards; contact boss checkpoint

beats.name: King phase 1 — The lunge
beats.purpose: King alone steps from throne, locks short lunge, commits and gives slash-range recovery

boss.name: Selenite King
boss.canonical_basis: seated royal figure and low seat; mobile lunge and formation fight are game inventions
boss.invented_weak_point: ordinary slash-range body during lunge recovery
boss.phase_retry: restore coherent phase start; no repeat stat rewards
boss.outcome: King defeated in game adaptation; exterior curtain opened

levels.name: The Living Moon
levels.subtitle: Departure Refused
levels.objective: Open the capsule hatch and escape the Moon
levels.skill: Evade a committed expression and return to a local slash-range eye rim
levels.mood: offended celestial face; controlled suspense; playful escape and release

beats.name: Wrinkled return
beats.purpose: Compact reused rock route; one impact and brief rusher rehearse useful landings

beats.name: Capsule checkpoint
beats.purpose: Blocked hatch, low eye rim, nearby nose and available floor preview before boss

beats.name: Moon phase 1 — Blink
beats.purpose: Circle samples actual world position once, locks, strikes; lowered eye-rim recovery

beats.name: Moon phase 2 — Sneeze
beats.purpose: Nose previews short cone, locks direction, releases; then alternates with known circle

beats.name: Moon phase 3 — Final expression
beats.purpose: Stagger known circle and cone; visible normal-dash safe pocket; same eye opening

beats.name: The hatch opens
beats.purpose: Flinch and contact hatch trigger short capsule/cord/clinging-Selenite escape; unlock Act 2

levels.mastery_evidence: Player reads two known shapes locally, chooses safe useful landing and reaches eye recovery with baseline slash

boss.name: Man in the Moon
boss.canonical_basis: film human-faced Moon and injured eye; all boss hostility, phases and weak-point rules are inventions
boss.invented_weak_point: lowered local eye rim at ordinary slash range
boss.blink_sampling: actual player world floor position once at windup start; visible lock before activation; no retarget
boss.sneeze_sampling: short world-space cone direction locks before release; no retarget
boss.outcome: Moon flinch opens local hatch; contact triggers escape and Act 2 access

gameplay_mockup_coverage: Crater Gardens committed rush and useful safe recovery landing
grotto hittable cluster and retreating living swarm
Moon circle/cone with safe landing and low slash-range eye opening
required_design_tests: new player hall direction demonstration; upper-left release/centre tap; zero-vector tap; camera movement
screen-edge release and ordinary safe repositioning swipe; no auto-aim or impossible outward tap
rusher lane commitment and useful recovery landing with normal dash
two mushrooms/about eight swarmers; deliberate cluster hit, live enemy retreat, finite supply and readable fade
slash-then-blast releases one cluster and consumes no extra charge while active
guard pair/King slash-only completion; finite helpers; meaningful attack opening; coherent phase retry
Moon separate Blink/Sneeze then combined; origin/warning/safe landing/eye rim in existing portrait camera
baseline slash-only completion with no pickups and no dash invulnerability dependence
muted audio and finger/scenery occlusion; square effects do not hide next tell
background and resume during warning, spores and phase transitions; consumed overlay tap
measure complete-level time with movement and transitions; revise estimates without padding waves
